The '''System Patroller''' was the standard patrol craft used by the [[Lant Mining Corporation]]'s [[Security Patrol]]. The design of the vessel was a modified [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].

System Patrollers were found in any [[Star system/Legends|system]] where the Lant Mining Corporation had a significant [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operation, and were deployed for patrol duties, customs interdiction, and system defense.
